scenes.name: Hero
scenes.vo: This is the monthly investor recap for 20/20 BioLabs, a clinical lab in Gaithersburg, Maryland, building early cancer detection from tumor proteins, plus a new longevity test on inflammatory biomarkers. Your speakers: CEO Jonathan Cohen and Director of Sales David Lees.

scenes.name: The business today
scenes.vo: Start with the business. Revenue runs between two-and-a-half and three million dollars a year, and it is growing forty to fifty percent. Twenty-nine new accounts landed in the second quarter. The step change ahead is Medicare reimbursement, targeted for twenty twenty-eight.

broll.prompt: abstract dot-grid and thin rising line graph, cobalt on off-white paper, minimal editorial motion

scenes.name: Proteins, not ctDNA
scenes.vo: The differentiator: 20/20 measures tumor proteins, not circulating tumor DNA. The signal shows up earlier, and every report carries the actual biomarker values, so repeat tests plot a trajectory over time. Groups disappointed with ctDNA-based tests are switching.

props.headline: Proteins, not ctDNA.

left.title: The ctDNA approach
left.body: Detects fragments of circulating tumor DNA shed into the bloodstream.

right.title: The 20/20 approach
right.body: Measures tumor proteins directly. Detection comes earlier, and each report shows the actual biomarker values.

props.chartCaption: Repeat tests plot a trajectory over time. Illustrative — each point is one test in a series.
props.pullquote: Groups disappointed with ctDNA-based tests are switching.

scenes.name: Best quarter
scenes.vo: Q2 was the best cancer-testing quarter in company history. The twenty-nine new accounts came from five categories: fire departments, occupational health groups, preventive health companies, nonprofits, and physician offices. The Maryland state firefighter screening program is live; Vermont is next.

props.headline: 29 new accounts in the best quarter yet.

scenes.vo: On the longevity side, a pilot with Giant Foods. Employees test first, pairing inflammatory biomarkers with dietary data. If it works, shelf placement could follow. An update is due at the October webinar.

scenes.name: East Asia
scenes.vo: The CEO's East Asia trip: a region with a strong prevention culture. He reconnected with collaborators, built new relationships, and gathered real-world data for FDA submissions and Medicare coverage, while scouting acquisitions. The plan: a royalty pool putting five percent of post-Medicare revenue back to the partner groups that contribute data.

props.headline: A 5% royalty pool for data partners.

Evaluating acquisition targets on the ground.

scenes.name: What happens next
scenes.vo: What is next, in four milestones. September's webinar covers the East Asia trip in detail. October brings Giant Foods pilot results. The first formal FDA meeting is planned for the fall. And Medicare reimbursement is the twenty twenty-eight target.

items.note: Coordinated with an FDA advisory firm, part of the multi-cancer test pathway.

items.note: Enabled by a bipartisan law — the step-change revenue driver.
